title: Mustertext – Bewerbung
text: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply for the position of a part-time helper. I am a student at a secondary school and I would like to gain work experience. I am interested in this job because I like working with people and helping others. At the moment, I am attending the fourth grade. I am a reliable, punctual and motivated person. Furthermore, I work carefully and take responsibility. Although I do not have much work experience yet, I often help at home and I am willing to learn new things. I would be happy to attend an interview. I am available in the afternoons and at weekends. Yours sincerely, Julia
translation: A quick, brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Did you see that? It is a classic test sentence!
